correctness.rationale: For n>=7, the graph-metric radius-two clique is wholly in a column A_j, one of 5n middle-column distance-two facets B_ij with endpoints (i,j-1),(i,j+1) and three middle rows, or a unit-square tetrahedron C_ij. The unique middle column when n>=7 prevents additional mixed facets. Six explicitly ordered free codimension-one pairs in each B, then two free pairs in each C, give exactly 30n+10n=40n elementary collapses. The remainder is a 5-by-n square-triangulated torus with each of n full meridian four-simplices attached along its five-edge meridian. Replacing each contractible four-simplex attachment by a meridian disk up to homotopy and killing one primitive generator in the torus presentation yields S1 wedge n S2. Counting Z faces (5n,20n,20n,5n,n) and reversing 40n pairs yields original (5n,30n,55n,35n,6n). The argument is uniformly combinatorial, not extrapolated from n=7.
